name: Újhartyán (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Újhartyán (a red, white and blue shield with bars and a sheaf of grain) above the name Újhartyán in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
